result: Add an exact-default-coefficient generate branch that forms signed 17-bit sums `d[0]+d[7]`, `d[1]+d[6]`, `d[2]+d[5]`, and `d[3]+d[4]`, then applies weights 3, 7, 12, and 18 using explicit shift-add expressions. Reduce those four signed 32-bit weighted terms with a carry-save tree and one final adder to drive the existing registered `y_out`; retain the existing generic parameter path for every other coefficient set. Keep `d[0:7]`, synchronous active-high reset behavior, `// @latency 1`, and all observable cycles unchanged, and preserve signed extension and 32-bit result semantics.
